## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated (`make test`)
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed
- [ ] Should this go upstream?
  - If yes: branch from `master` as `upstream/<name>`, use `git commit -s` (DCO), run `make upstream-check`, and open a PR against [ovh/venom](https://github.com/ovh/venom). See [docs/UPSTREAM.md](../docs/UPSTREAM.md).
  - If no: keep the branch as `feature/*` or `fix/*` based on `internal/develop`.
